$comment: Root index of contract families. A family exists here or it does not exist. validate_contracts.py checks this in both directions: every directory has a row, every row has a directory.

families.name: common
families.description: Shapes referenced across families. Adding one here rather than duplicating it is what keeps two families from drifting on the same concept.

families.name: endpoints
families.description: Model B endpoint addressing: the routing selector beneath a PeerId, its configuration, direct destinations, the delivered event, and the endpoint-directory reply.

families.name: ipc
families.description: The local IPC v2 boundary: handshake and endpoint claim, capability grants, the message-class frame body, and the directed-send parameters whose deliberate omission of a source endpoint is what makes the source non-spoofable.
